email.body: With your team hiring for machine learning and engineering roles, managing access across cloud accounts becomes complex. Acme Access provides a single view to right-size permissions and prevent over-privileged roles, ensuring your rapid scaling doesn't lead to security breaches.
email.subject: Securing Shopify's engineering growth

linkedin.body: As Shopify scales its engineering teams, managing cloud access across environments gets harder. Acme Access helps security teams right-size permissions automatically to prevent over-privileged roles.

call.body: I noticed Shopify is expanding its engineering teams. As you scale, how are you ensuring engineers don't retain standing admin rights that could increase your attack surface?

objections.objection: We already have robust identity management in place.
objections.response: Acme Access specializes in right-sizing access across multi-cloud environments to prevent over-privileged roles that standard tools often miss.

objections.objection: Our current security processes are sufficient for our scale.
objections.response: As you continue to grow, Acme Access automates access reviews that typically take weeks of manual spreadsheet work.

objections.objection: We prefer to build our own internal security tools.
objections.response: Acme Access provides a specialized view across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud that is difficult to build and maintain internally.
